senses.gloss:
ITA-9.7.23 ariṣṭa-bandhanam (viṣopakramaḥ) अरिष्ट-बन्धनम् (विषोपक्रमः)
Tourniquet and ligature accompanied or not by chanting
Application of a tourniquet to stop the spread of poison which may or may not be accompanied by chanting of a specific mantra.

ITA-4.5.29 ariṣṭalakṣaṇam अरिष्टलक्षणम्
Sign or symptom of impending death
The presence of ominous signs and symptoms indicative of a poor prognosis or impending death.
